summaryZh: Chien 实验室的官方负责人介绍聚焦血流力学如何影响心血管系统，以及血流、血细胞与动脉壁的相互作用。研究涉及动脉粥样硬化、高血压及机械力如何影响基因表达、细胞生长和迁移，采用纳米技术、DNA 微阵列、生物信息学、细胞生物物理与生物力学等方法。
researchQuestions: 血流机械力如何影响心血管系统和细胞基因表达？

evidence.quote: Chien Lab Principal Investigator: Shu Chien
Research on how the forces of blood flow impact the cardiovascular system.
At the molecular level, he is discovering how mechanical forces signal gene expression to cause cell growth, migration and cell death.
He employs an array of technologies including nanotechnology, DNA microarrary, bioinformatics, cell biophysics and biomechanics in his research on the cardiovascular system.
